## QC details

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
### Coverage summary

```{r coverage-table}
# The widget must be the chunk's value, not print()ed: under quarto_render() print.htmlwidget writes to a temp file and emits nothing
cov_dt = function(x) DT::datatable(x, rownames = FALSE,
                                   options = list(pageLength = 30, dom = "ft",
                                                  scrollY = "300px"))
show_normal_cov = outputs$has_normal && !is.null(qc_normal_mosdepth) && nrow(qc_normal_mosdepth$table) > 0
have_cov = !is.null(qc_mosdepth$table) && nrow(qc_mosdepth$table) > 0

htmltools::tagList(
  if (show_normal_cov) tags$p(tags$strong("Tumour")),
  if (have_cov) cov_dt(qc_mosdepth$table) else section_notice("Mosdepth summary not available."),
  if (show_normal_cov) tags$p(tags$strong("Normal")),
  if (show_normal_cov) cov_dt(qc_normal_mosdepth$table)
)
```
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
### Alignment statistics (samtools flagstat)

```{r flagstat-table, results='asis'}
# Number formatting shared with the cramino table below; NULL/NA -> "N/A"
fmt_qc = function(x, digits = 0) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0 || is.na(x[1])) return("N/A")
  formatC(as.numeric(x[1]), format = "f", digits = digits, big.mark = ",")
}
# Keys are parse_flagstat()'s (FLAGSTAT_LABELS order). "mapped" counts every mapped record,
# secondary and supplementary included; "primary mapped" is the per-read figure.
FLAGSTAT_DISPLAY = c(
  total              = "Total records",
  primary            = "Primary records",
  secondary          = "Secondary alignments",
  supplementary      = "Supplementary alignments",
  duplicate          = "Duplicates",
  primary_duplicates = "Primary duplicates",
  mapped             = "Mapped records (incl. secondary/supplementary)",
  primary_mapped     = "Primary mapped reads",
  paired             = "Paired in sequencing"
)
flagstat_df = function(fs) {
  keys = intersect(names(FLAGSTAT_DISPLAY), names(fs))
  data.frame(metric = unname(FLAGSTAT_DISPLAY[keys]),
             value = vapply(keys, function(k) fmt_qc(fs[[k]]), character(1)),
             row.names = NULL)
}
show_normal_fs = outputs$has_normal && length(qc_normal_flagstat) > 0
if (show_normal_fs) cat("**Tumour**\n\n")
if (length(qc_flagstat) > 0) {
  print(knitr::kable(flagstat_df(qc_flagstat), row.names = FALSE))
} else {
  cat("Flagstat file not available.\n")
}
if (show_normal_fs) {
  cat("\n\n**Normal**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(flagstat_df(qc_normal_flagstat), row.names = FALSE))
}
```
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
### Read quality + alignment statistics

```{r cramino-table, results='asis'}
make_quality_df = function(cr, st) {
  rows = list()
  # cramino 2.0 reports N50 twice: over full read lengths ("N50") and over the aligned part of
  # each read ("N50 aligned"). 1.x has only the first, which is then left unqualified.
  if (!is.na(cr$n50_aligned)) {
    rows[["Read N50, full read length (bp)"]] = fmt_qc(cr$n50)
    rows[["Read N50, aligned portion (bp)"]]  = fmt_qc(cr$n50_aligned)
  } else {
    rows[["Read N50 (bp)"]] = fmt_qc(cr$n50)
  }
  rows[["Yield (Gb)"]]     = fmt_qc(cr$yield_gb, 2)
  rows[["% mapped"]]       = fmt_qc(cr$mapped_pct, 2)
  rows[["# reads"]]        = fmt_qc(cr$n_reads)
  if (!is.null(st)) {
    rows[["Avg read length (bp)"]] = fmt_qc(st$avg_length)
    rows[["Max read length (bp)"]] = fmt_qc(st$max_length)
    rows[["Avg base quality"]]     = fmt_qc(st$avg_quality, 1)
    rows[["Bases mapped (Gb)"]]    = fmt_qc(st$bases_mapped / 1e9, 2)
    rows[["Error rate"]]           = if (!is.na(st$error_rate))
      paste0(formatC(st$error_rate * 100, format = "f", digits = 3), "%") else "N/A"
  }
  data.frame(metric = names(rows), value = unlist(rows), row.names = NULL)
}

show_normal_cr = outputs$has_normal
if (show_normal_cr) cat("**Tumour**\n\n")
print(knitr::kable(make_quality_df(qc_cramino, samtools_stats), row.names = FALSE))
if (show_normal_cr) {
  cat("\n\n**Normal**\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(make_quality_df(qc_normal_cramino, qc_normal_samtools_stats), row.names = FALSE))
}
```
